7a907edc6035d7ddd365.text: Bias and prejudice are commonly viewed as being closely related. They are

fbc4a865a878fbafd686.text: forming opinion before being aware of the facts of a case concerned.

6848e538b3ec66ea6c07.text: as how we interact with individuals in a given group, what advice we consider and how we perform.

146672c775868a1d18a0.text: The first scenarios show favoritism and classified as bias. The second show discrimination for it tells us unfavorable opinion and pre-judges others and that’s what we call prejudice.

179a7bc662767496bad4.text: Bias – means a tendency to favor a person, group or thing or point of view over

9bc91e328b75ee7e357c.text: another, often in an unfair way. Example: Female teachers give more attention to girls.

3e1ecd44ff3bd95fb8e1.text: Prejudice – is an unfavorable opinion or feeling formed beforehand or without

bb807aef8d6d85782692.text: knowledge, though or reason. It simply means pre-judge others. Example: It is sometimes assumed that someone who is physically disabled is also mentally disabled.
